name: jarvis-client

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "NEXT,HTTPS,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "next dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && node electron-scripts/https-proxy.js" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run build:electron && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run sync:mediapipe && npm run optimize:assets && npm run build:python && npm run build:next && node electron-scripts/postbuild.js && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run clean:release && electron-builder --mac --win --publish never
scripts.test: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --test --experimental-strip-types app/lib/hermes-gateway.test.ts app/lib/hermes-stream.test.ts app/lib/functions.test.ts app/api/hermes/route.test.ts app/api/hermes/sessions/route.test.ts "app/api/hermes/sessions/[id]/messages/route.test.ts" scripts/elevenlabs-prompt.test.mjs

//dependencies: Only what the Electron main process require()s at runtime. electron-builder ships this list (plus its transitive deps) into app.asar, so anything the renderer or Next server uses belongs in devDependencies — Next already bundles or traces those into .next/standalone.
